description: Right-click menu on the host dropdown of Record's Notebooks header, as Baude's New session has for its hosts. Only for another machine's host. (Right-click here is a long-press on a touch screen.)

parts.name: Deactivate / Activate
parts.shows: "Deactivate", or "Activate" when the host is already deactivated.

actions.does: Turns the host off or on for the mesh (kept). Toast "{host} deactivated" or "{host} activated". While it is off the banner over the notebooks says "{host} is deactivated".
